_comment: Watchlist. Prices are in EUR, 'landed' in Ireland (incl. 23% IE VAT). fair = normal street price (landed in IE, set from 7 Nov 2026 prices), good = solid sale, excellent = buy-it-now price. wow_score 1-10 weights CPU single-thread heavily (WoW + ElvUI/WeakAuras-style addons are CPU-bound) then GPU, screen, cooling. Edit freely.

laptops.name: HP OMEN 16 (2025)
laptops.search: HP OMEN 16 ap1190ng OR ap0192ng Ryzen 9 8940HX RTX 5070
laptops.notes: 16-core HX CPU = great for raid/city FPS with addons. HyperX-branded SKUs (16-ap1xxx) are the same machine.

laptops.name: Lenovo LOQ 17IRX10
laptops.notes: Strong CPU for the money, big screen, budget chassis. 15" LOQ 15IRX10 with same CPU/GPU is an acceptable substitute.

laptops.name: Gigabyte Gaming A16 3WH
laptops.notes: Cheapest RTX 5070 laptop. Avoid the Core i7-13620H variant (weaker CPU for WoW).

laptops.name: Acer Nitro V 16 AI
laptops.search: Acer Nitro V 16 AI ANV16-42 RTX 5070
laptops.notes: Good value; 17" Nitro V 17 AI (ANV17-41) also counts.

laptops.name: MSI Katana 15/17 HX
laptops.notes: HX CPU, often 1440p panel. Loud under load.

laptops.name: ASUS TUF Gaming A16/A18 (2025)
laptops.search: ASUS TUF Gaming A16 2025 FA608 RTX 5070 OR TUF A18 FA808UP
laptops.notes: Solid cooling, good battery. Ryzen 9 8940HX SKU (FA608PP) is the better WoW pick.

laptops.name: Gigabyte AERO X16
laptops.notes: Thin and light (~1.9kg) - the portable option. GPU runs at lower wattage.

laptops.name: Lenovo Legion 5 15IRX10 (OLED)
laptops.notes: Best screen + build in the list. Over budget at normal price; reviewed at EUR1,499 - a deal target.

laptops.name: Lenovo Legion Pro 5 16ADR10
laptops.notes: The 'dream' pick: 16-core HX, 32GB, top cooling. Only buy at the top of your budget (<= EUR1,600-1,750).

laptops.name: Medion Erazer Defender 17 P10
laptops.search: Medion Erazer Defender 17 P10 RTX 5070 overclockers
laptops.notes: Overclockers UK pick. UK price converted to EUR and Irish VAT (see Settings). i9-14900HX = very high WoW FPS.

laptops.name: MSI Vector 16 HX AI (RTX 5070 Ti) - wildcard
laptops.search: MSI Vector 16 HX AI RTX 5070 Ti A2XWHG
laptops.notes: Only interesting if a Black Friday deal drops it to ~EUR1,600. Weak screen.
